sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 335 crisis level, rising USD, NFP event today) combined with earnings in 18 days creates severe risk environment for GOOG.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technicals (supertrend, hull, psar bullish) + extreme fear sentiment (18/100) + contrarian buy signal create a potential capitulation bounce setup near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, below Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF, overbought stochRSI, earnings in 18 days, VIX crisis level (335), inverted yield curve, and macro headwinds (rising USD, NFP today) create severe structural and event risk that overwhelms short-term technicals.
